request.intent: Resolve the recorded winui2-to-winui3-resources-and-theming capability boundary for Calculator\Calculator.csproj. Preserve the approved requirements and existing behavior; do not invent architecture. ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView has no registered deterministic repair yet. The UWP ResourceLoader factory is bound to a current view, which a desktop WinUI process does not have. ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView is unsafe in the desktop current-view model. Detection is read-only; no source repair is registered in this change.
